items.positive_definition: Repeated back-and-forth walking or repeated traversal of the same visible path.
exclusions: Repeated paths or back-and-forth walking; camera cannot establish aimlessness or exclude purposeful walking without context.
Do not infer intent, diagnosis, agitation cause, injury, social appropriateness, or caregiver frequency from movement alone.
evidence_needs: Repeated paths or back-and-forth walking; camera cannot establish aimlessness or exclude purposeful walking without context.
Timestamped source frames for the same session-local track; record missing or occluded evidence as uncertain.
